meta.title: Scenario: dense team (Tideway Product Team)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-scenarios.ts (dense-team) with seed 20261106. 18 members of one product team, grouped by discipline in the team attribute. Everyone works with everyone: connection strength 3 to 5, formal collaboration at least weekly, informal collaboration at least monthly, valence positive. Small differences remain (same discipline slightly stronger; four working pairs strongest). Every rating was given except one declined valence rating.

layers.label: Connection strength
layers.question_wording: How strong is your working connection with this person?

layers.label: Valence
layers.question_wording: Overall, how positive or negative is your working relationship with this person?

layers.label: Informal collaboration
layers.question_wording: How often do you collaborate with this person outside formal roles, processes or reporting lines?

layers.label: Formal collaboration
layers.question_wording: How often does your role, a process or a reporting line require you to collaborate with this person?

layers.label: Advice and information seeking
layers.question_wording: Who do you go to for work-related information or advice?

layers.label: Competence-based trust
layers.question_wording: I rely on this person’s expertise and judgement.

layers.label: Benevolence-based trust
layers.question_wording: This person would look out for my interests.

layers.label: Energy
layers.question_wording: Interactions with this person typically leave me energised / drained.

layers.label: Decision influence
layers.question_wording: This person’s input materially affects my decisions.

layers.label: Workflow dependency
layers.question_wording: I cannot complete my work without this person’s output.

layers.label: Knowledge awareness
layers.question_wording: I understand what this person knows and can do.

layers.label: Idea sharing
layers.question_wording: I would take a new or untested idea to this person.

layers.label: Interpersonal safety
layers.question_wording: I can raise a concern or admit a mistake with this person without fear of negative consequences.

layers.label: Conflict: task disagreement
layers.question_wording: How often do you experience task disagreement with this person?

layers.label: Conflict: personal friction
layers.question_wording: How often do you experience personal friction with this person?

layers.label: Primary channel
layers.question_wording: Which channel do you mainly use with this person?
